normalized_statement: A fixed Bitraf64 seed plus a versioned KDF/PRF and domain/counter schedule can reproducibly generate the declared matrices bit-for-bit across conforming implementations.
source_expression: Bitraf64 as deterministic seed of matrices / K_domain=KDF/PRF(K0,version||domain||counter)
falsifier: Two conforming implementations using the frozen specification produce different output bytes for the same seed/domain/counter inputs.

normalized_statement: The declared toroidal addressing plus spiral weighting/traversal provides a useful generative or compression ordering relative to declared non-toroidal and non-spiral baselines.
source_expression: Toro + spiral as useful generative/compressive traversal = HYPOTHESIS/TO_PROVE
falsifier: No preregistered improvement in the declared metric over matched baselines or the effect disappears under ablation.

normalized_statement: For canonically aligned three-image inputs whose disagreement syndrome is sufficiently sparse, majority-base plus origin-syndrome serialization yields smaller total encoded size than storing the three inputs under a declared baseline while preserving byte-exact reconstruction.
source_expression: gain of compression in 3 images by sparse syndrome = HYPOTHESIS/TO_PROVE
supported_mechanism: For three binary copies, majority M plus divergence-origin syndrome S is sufficient to reconstruct the three bits; compression rate is data-dependent and unmeasured globally.
falsifier: Roundtrip fails or total serialized bytes are not smaller than the declared baseline in the preregistered sparse-syndrome regime.

normalized_statement: ZIPRAF achieves a 2x to 5x compression improvement under a fully specified corpus, metric and baseline.
falsifier: Measured compression improvement falls outside the declared interval under the frozen benchmark protocol.

normalized_statement: The declared Ethica operation completes in less than one millisecond under a specified workload, hardware, software environment and latency statistic.
falsifier: The preregistered latency statistic is at least one millisecond under the frozen benchmark protocol.

normalized_statement: A ZIPRAF component yields a 30% to 70% gain on a specific measurable target relative to a declared baseline.
blocking_reason: The target metric/component/baseline is not fixed in the audited root narrative.
falsifier: Once operationalized, the measured gain does not reach the declared interval.

normalized_statement: The declared ZIPRAF integrity mechanism detects 100% of adversarial modifications inside a fully specified threat model and verification boundary.
known_boundary: Hash/checksum verification exists, but internal integrity is not equivalent to authenticity and a universal 100% statement requires a bounded threat model.
falsifier: Any mutation within the declared threat model is accepted as valid without detection.

normalized_statement: The declared geometric/layered recovery mechanism reconstructs the original payload with digest equality under admissible erasure masks removing up to 40% to 45% of the represented structure.
known_boundary: Current local theorem tests remove one node and check connectivity/mean weight; they do not reconstruct arbitrary payloads or establish a 40-45% threshold.
required_closures: physical-device receipt if claimed beyond sandbox
falsifier: An admissible mask within the declared 40-45% budget prevents exact payload recovery or digest equality.
